comment: No source is published. The frequency knob runs 0.08 to 0.99 with a default of 0.5 and is displayed as a percentage; resonance runs 0.00001 to 0.99 with a default of 0.0001, so the filter starts with essentially none. The unnamed knob runs 1 to 3, snapped, and the value is passed straight through as the model number to VcfModels::setParams. The filter is run four times oversampled. JuicyVCF does no work at all unless a cable is in the output: the output port's channel count is tested before the filter is called and again before the channel count is set. The two frequency CV jacks read voltages at the loop's channel index rather than through getPolyVoltage, so a one-channel cable in either of them reaches only the first voice. The accent envelope is advanced only while the accent jack is connected, and its last value is otherwise retained and still multiplies the cutoff. The panel prints JUICY, OTA SVF, FREQUENCY, RESONANCE, ACCENT, INPUT and, under the audio output jack, 24db; the two frequency CV jacks and three of the knobs carry no lettering at all.
